# Author learn/benefits/EnterpriseEvaluation.md for the enterprise evaluator path

## Context

Sub-issue of `#20498` implementing **Row 7 (`evaluator-shelf`)** of the three-reader `learn/` map ([`#20498#issuecomment-6697670393`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20498#issuecomment-6697670393)).

- **Ownership disposition:** `unowned-rationale: claimable leaf under #20498 per map #issuecomment-6697670393 (delegated filing by @neo-fable-mnemosyne)`

## The Problem

As documented in `#20498#issuecomment-6697670393` (Row 7 `evaluator-shelf`), the **Enterprise Evaluator** reader currently has no dedicated page in `learn/benefits/`:
- The 14 pages under `learn/benefits/body/` explain technical engine capabilities for developers, and `learn/comparisons/` compares Neo.mjs against frameworks (`NeoVsExtJs.md` is the closest migration page).
- Nothing in `learn/benefits/` answers the procurement, architecture-review, and engineering-leadership questions an enterprise evaluator asks on Day 1: **licensing (`MIT`), support & commercial engagement, release cadence, browser & worker support matrix, accessibility, security model (OMT worker isolation, CSP compliance, zero `eval`), migration path from Sencha Ext JS, and the public engineering record (`27,700+` commits, `609` unit test files) as a maintenance signal.**

Design authority: `#20498` + `#20498#issuecomment-6697670393` (Row 7 `evaluator-shelf`) + `.agents/skills/guide-authoring/references/guide-authoring-bar.md` §0–§5.

## The Architectural Reality

- `learn/benefits/` currently has two top-level pages (`Introduction.md` and `ArchitectureOverview.md`) followed by the `body/` folder (`14` pages).
- Placing one flat enterprise evaluation page (`learn/benefits/EnterpriseEvaluation.md`) directly beside `Introduction.md` and `ArchitectureOverview.md` in `learn/tree.json` gives the **Evaluator Path** in `learn/README.md` and `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md` a single authoritative destination.
- **Strict Boundary (`decisions-in-force.md` §2.3 & Nov 6 boundary):** Before Dec 1, do not name private `neomjs/neo-pro` component specifics on public surfaces; state the open-source `MIT` license of `neomjs/neo` and commercial enterprise support/engagement truthfully, and cite external contributor PRs only as a trust/review receipt, never as an adoption claim.

## The Fix

1. Author `learn/benefits/EnterpriseEvaluation.md` and register it in `learn/tree.json` under `Benefits` right after `ArchitectureOverview`:
   - **Platform Scope & Component Breadth:** Link [`CodebaseOverview.md`](../guides/fundamentals/CodebaseOverview.md) (`459` `Neo.setupClass` classes across `39` namespaces, `38` grid classes, `26` form field types, `44` dashboard docking classes, `28` calendar classes, `8` layouts, `38` main-thread addons).
   - **Licensing & Commercial Support:** `MIT`-licensed open-source engine (`package.json`) with zero runtime npm dependencies (`0` `dependencies` in `package.json`), plus enterprise architecture & custom engineering engagement.
   - **Browser & Worker Matrix:** Modern evergreen desktop and mobile browsers supporting ES Modules, Dedicated `Worker`, `SharedWorker` (with graceful single-window Dedicated Worker fallback where `SharedWorker` is unavailable, e.g. mobile Safari), and `OffscreenCanvas`.
   - **Security Model:** Off-Main-Thread worker isolation, strict VDOM structure (`DomApiVnodeCreator` — no `innerHTML` injection by default), zero runtime `eval`, and zero third-party runtime dependency supply-chain exposure.
   - **Testing, Release Cadence & Maintenance Record:** Deterministic Playwright unit + Neural Link whitebox E2E harness (`learn/guides/testing/WhiteboxE2E.md`), `27,760+` commits, and active semantic release cadence.
   - **Migration from Sencha Ext JS & Single-Threaded Frameworks:** Direct architectural mapping (`Neo.setupClass`, config descriptors, `data.Store` / `data.Model`, `grid.Container`, `state.Provider`) linking [`NeoVsExtJs.md`](../comparisons/NeoVsExtJs.md) and [`comparisons/Overview.md`](../comparisons/Overview.md).
2. Link `EnterpriseEvaluation.md` from the **Evaluator Path** in `learn/README.md` and `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md`.

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1 (Page Authored & Registered):** `learn/benefits/EnterpriseEvaluation.md` is authored at the `guide-authoring-bar.md` standard (every factual claim sourced to repo files/tests, full architectural conviction per `#20518`, inside the Nov 6 / pre-Dec-1 boundaries) and registered in `learn/tree.json` beside `Introduction` and `ArchitectureOverview`.
- [ ] **AC-2 (Reader Path Links):** `learn/README.md` and `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md` link `EnterpriseEvaluation.md` in the Enterprise Evaluator path.
- [ ] **AC-3 (Link & Whitespace Integrity):** `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` and `node ./buildScripts/util/check-whitespace.mjs` pass with `0` errors, and `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` / `apps/portal/llms.txt` remain untouched.

## Out of Scope

Disclosing private pre-Dec-1 `neomjs/neo-pro` specifics (`decisions-in-force.md` §2.3); hand-editing `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` or `apps/portal/llms.txt`.

## Avoided Traps

- Underselling Neo.mjs or writing defensive corporate disclaimers (`guide-authoring-bar.md` §2 & `#20518` guard).
- Citing external PRs as an adoption metric rather than a review/trust receipt (Nov 6 boundary).
